items.prompt: Using an upward sum scan for one item 2 and target 4 can produce which incorrect reuse?

options.text: It cannot reach ways[2] from ways[0].
options.why: Upward order does reach ways[2]; that is what creates the next erroneous dependency.

options.text: It reuses item 2 to form sum 4.
options.why: The current layer feeds itself, turning 0/1 use into repeated use.

options.text: It rejects 2 because target 4 is larger.
options.why: The item is eligible; the error is reusing it.

options.text: It counts the empty subset as a negative sum.
options.why: No negative state is involved in this counterexample.

items.explanation: The current layer feeds itself, turning 0/1 use into repeated use.
